description: Where every native runtime operation (A006) is served by the VMM backend contract (A501). `status` is `verified` when `verification` names a passing parity test. Operations only long-running runtimes use (docker, fire, modal) stay open until a live provider test covers them.

homes.node: stays in the node, using the A501 operation in `target` when set
homes.backend: inside the native backend, invisible to the node

exclude.wasm: exec_vm only validated the module path and echoed it
exclude.javascript: exec_vm only transpiled the module and echoed it
exclude.elpian: exec_vm was start: an invocation, served by invokeWorkload
exclude.elpify: exec_vm was run_vm: an invocation, served by invokeWorkload

init.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_native (the backend registers its plugins)

detect.note: Whether the runtime is usable on this host decides whether it is listed.

meta.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_native (describe: capabilities and deploy conventions)

create.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native system (create over A501, observed running)

destroy.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-conformance check_backend via live_native; system (delete converges)

pause.verification: aseman-application unsupported_operations_are_refused_not_degraded: no native runtime pauses, and the service refuses it

restore.note: Modal's restore re-attaches its own persisted sandbox entries; the native backend uses it when adopting ModalSandbox handles (ADR 0022). It never takes snapshots, so no native runtime declares `snapshot`. Modal needs an account and API key, which this environment has none of; it is unverified here.

run_vm.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_native and system (counter.js runs as its workload)

exec_vm.note: Runs a command in a live instance. Where legacy exec_vm was an echo or an invocation, the runtime reports `exec: false` (see capability_rules).
exec_vm.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): a command runs inside the container (LD-29 fixed)

status_vm.note: Not used by the native backend: it reports its own instances, and A501 `getWorkload` answers what the VMM observed.
status_vm.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native system (A501 getWorkload answers from the observed record)

delete_vm.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-conformance check_backend via live_native; system (delete converges)

build_image.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): the Dockerfile is built before the first start

build_delete_request.note: Not used: the native backend addresses instances through the plan_* hooks, which the docker test verifies.

build_terminate_request.note: Not used: the native backend addresses instances through the plan_* hooks, which the docker test verifies.

plan_run_entity.note: Launch planning is the backend's; the node sends a complete spec.
plan_run_entity.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): the container launches from the plugin's plan

plan_stop_entity.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): the container stops from the plugin's plan

plan_delete_entity.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): the container is removed from the plugin's plan

copy_to_vm.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): a text file is copied into the container

copy_from_vm.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon) and the A504 conformance kit: a file the runtime cannot read back is `not_found`

forward_http.note: Runtimes without `http_ingress` are reached by invokeWorkload, as legacy fell back to signalling.
forward_http.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): HTTP reaches the server inside the container

vm_endpoints.verification: aseman-vmm-backend-native live_docker (real Docker daemon): a docker entity publishes none

identify_instance_by_ip.note: Replaced by the workload credential for host calls. The docker-host gateway still resolves a container's source IP to its workload inside the backend; a container speaking the gateway protocol is exercised with the P6 worker-agent tests.

verify_program_execution.note: Elpify proofs: the backend verifies a program it holds, through A501 `verifyExecution`. Verifying one end to end needs an elpify program and proof fixture (P8 finance/consensus work uses them).
